title: Mock Data artifact
description: The canonical sample dataset for a set of entities in a component. ONE per entity per component; it grows, it is never duplicated. test-writer builds fixtures from records; frontend-coder populates mockups from records.

superseded_by.description: id of the artifact replacing this one when status=deprecated.

reusable.description: true if other flows/components may reuse this dataset.

realization.description: Origin of the dataset: mock = sample/demo product content (the default meaning for mock-data); spec = aspirational shape for a not-yet-built dataset; built = mirrors a real on-disk dataset. OPTIONAL — absent defaults to 'built'. Parallels flow.realization.

invariants.description: Human/machine rules the records must satisfy (e.g. 'Plant.status==out-of-stock iff stock==0'). Checked by the validator.

entities.description: Keyed by entity name (e.g. Plant). Each has a field spec and sample records.
